name: Mendikot
description: Mendikot is a trick-taking card game from India, particularly popular in the western states of Maharashtra and Gujarat. It is a partnership game where the objective is to win tricks containing tens. The name comes from Gujarati where 'mendi' refers to the zero in '10' and 'kot' means a decisive victory where opponents score nothing.

history.origins: Mendikot originated in western India, specifically in Maharashtra and Gujarat. The game reflects the Indian tradition of trick-taking games with specific card targets.
timeline: Traditional: Played for generations in western India
20th Century: Rules passed down through families and communities
Present: Still popular in Maharashtra and Gujarat, and among Indian communities abroad
history.cultural: A social game played in Indian households and community gatherings. The focus on capturing tens reflects the cultural significance of round numbers.
history.evolution: The game has remained relatively stable, with minor regional variations in dealing and scoring.

setup.players: 4 players in fixed partnerships, partners sitting opposite each other.
setup.deck: Standard 52-card deck. Ranking: A (high), K, Q, J, 10, 9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2 (low).
setup.dealing: 13 cards to each player, dealt in packets. The dealer is always a member of the losing team from the previous deal.

rules.objective: Win tricks containing the tens (10s). Capturing all four tens scores a 'kot' (decisive victory).
rules.gameplay: Standard trick-taking: must follow suit if possible. Highest card of led suit wins the trick. There are no trumps.
keyRules: Dealer is from the losing team

strategy.basic: Try to win tricks that contain 10s. Save high cards for tricks where 10s are played. Communicate with your partner through card play.
strategy.intermediate: Track which 10s have been played. Force opponents to use high cards on non-10 tricks. Set up situations where you can capture multiple 10s.
strategy.advanced: Card counting is essential. Track all high cards to know when your cards are unbeatable. Coordinate with partner to ensure coverage of all suits.
tips: The 10s are everything - don't waste high cards on tricks without them unless necessary
If your partner plays a high card, they may be signaling strength in that suit
Try to void yourself in a suit so you can discard strategically on 10 tricks
Achieving Kot requires perfect coordination with your partner

scoring.description: Points are scored for capturing 10s. A Kot (all four 10s) is the ultimate goal.
scoring.winCondition: Capture the majority of tens, or achieve a Kot by capturing all four tens.
